title: Le Conditionnel Passé
description: would have + past participle: regrets and unreal pasts.

items.translation: Conditionnel présent of avoir or être + past participle
items.exampleEn: I would have liked; she would have come.

items.translation: Regret, reproach, an unreal past after si + plus-que-parfait, and unconfirmed news
items.exampleFr: Tu aurais dû me le dire. Si j'avais su, je serais venu.
items.exampleEn: You should have told me. If I had known, I would have come.

items.prompt: In French: “I should have studied.”
In French: “You could have told me.”  (tu)
items.answer: Tu aurais pu me le dire

items.prompt: In French: “I would have liked to come.”
In French: “We should have left earlier.”
items.answer: Nous aurions dû partir plus tôt
accept: On aurait dû partir plus tôt

items.prompt: Si j'avais su, je ___ plus tôt.
Sans ton aide, je n'___ jamais réussi.
Selon la presse, le ministre ___ hier soir.
items.explain: The conditionnel passé reports unconfirmed news.

items.translation: j'aurais fini — I would have finished

items.prompt: In French (conditionnel passé): “You (one friend) would have finished”  (finir)
